name: service
description: The legacy service management wrapper: forwards to systemctl on systemd systems and to init.d scripts on older ones.

flags.description: List all services with state markers [+] running, [-] stopped.

examples.explanation: Works identically on SysV and systemd systems — that is its remaining value: old scripts and muscle memory.
Quick inventory of service states on any system.

about: service is a compatibility layer. On systemd distributions it translates to systemctl calls; genuinely SysV-only systems (rare now) run /etc/init.d/ scripts directly. New scripts should call systemctl explicitly.
useCases: Portability across old and new init systems.
mistakes: Using service for systemd-specific operations (enable, list-units) — it does not support them.
distroNotes: Present on Debian/Ubuntu and RHEL-family; behavior differs by init system.
